command: set -euo pipefail; echo MACHINE=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo TIME=$(date -Is); systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service; printf 'repo='; if [ -d /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein/.git ]; then echo /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein; elif [ -d /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo/.git ]; then echo /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo; else echo NONE; fi; for d in /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo ===$d===; git -C "$d" status --short --branch; git -C "$d" remote -v | head -4; fi; done
